subject: Mosaic Health — early-volume rebate & packaging consolidation request (VP/CFO sign-off)
messages:
From: Angela Park <angela.park@mosaichealth.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@mosaichealth.com
Date: 2027-04-04T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mosaic Health — request for early-volume rebate and packaging consolidation

Hi Irene / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Mosaic is excited about the latency profile and the private deployment option — this is a hard requirement for our inpatient workflows. We have a procurement timeline that accelerates in May, but we need a commercial structure that makes the pilot economics attractive while we ramp to the annual commitment.

High-level ask:
- 12-month minimum term after pilot with an annualized commitment target of ~$1.2M ARR.
- Requesting an "early-volume rebate": a one-time credit applied to months 1–6 to offset initial ramp costs.
- Ask for packaging consolidation (single bundle covering embeddings + chat + reranking) rather than separate product line items to simplify procurement and lower applied per-token unit pricing.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accommodate a rebate structure and consolidated SKU? Procurement would like a commercial summary and a draft SOW this week. Attaching our RFP PDF for context.

Regards,
Angela Park
Senior Procurement Manager
Mosaic Health

Ben (AE) — looping you in to build the commercial summary and a draft SOW. Can you assemble an options table we can present to Mosaic: (a) one-time early rebate applied to first 6 months; (b) onboarding credit + smaller ongoing discount; (c) standard list pricing with packaging consolidation but no rebate. Please include estimated impact to first-year revenue and the recommended path.

Marissa — FYI, this is likely to need VP/CFO sign-off due to the requested rebate size and packaging concessions.

I'll draft a short exec note for approval once Ben has numbers.

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: 2027-04-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Commercial options & recommendation — Mosaic Health (DEAL-2027-327)

Team / Angela — attached is the commercial_summary_mosaic_v3.xlsx with three priced options and P&L impact slides. Summary below.

Option A (Recommended):
- Upfront one-time rebate = 18% of committed ARR, applied as a credit across months 1–6 (reduces near-term cash but improves pilot economics).
- Packaging: Consolidated bundle (Embeddings + Chat + Rerank) at blended unit price ~12% below our standard list for these SKUs.
- Conditions: 12-month committed term following pilot; minimum monthly usage floor; standard T&Cs otherwise.
- Business rationale: accelerates procurement approval and reduces friction for the technical teams to run one integration.

Option B (Alternative):
- $150k onboarding credit (one-time) + 10% ongoing bundle discount for first year.

Option C (Conservative):
- Consolidated packaging only; no rebate/credit.

Financial ask: we will need VP/CFO approval for Option A (18%) given modeled net revenue dilution and precedent. Attached SOW draft for review.

Attachments: commercial_summary_mosaic_v3.xlsx, SOW_draft_Mosaic_v2.pdf

Next steps: Irene / Marissa — can you route to finance for an impact check and then to Rishi for signoff?Angela — if you prefer Option B we can move faster; Option A requires internal review.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; irene_choi@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-05T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Financial impact analysis — Mosaic options (quick read)

Folks — I ran the numbers on the worksheet and pushed through a quick sensitivity model. Key points:
- Baseline committed ARR: $1.2M
- Option A (18% one-time rebate applied to months 1–6):
  - Recognized revenue year1 (after rebate): ~$960k
  - Cash impact (year1): -$216k vs list
  - LTV impact: modest but recoverable by year 2 assuming usage floor met
- Option B ($150k onboarding credit + 10% ongoing year1):
  - Recognized revenue year1: ~$1.02M
  - Cash impact (year1): -$180k vs list
- Option C: no material revenue dilution; faster cash collection post-pilot.

Recommendation: Approve a capped rebate structure — up to 15% one-time rebate OR a $100k onboarding credit + 10% first-year discount. If we go above 15% the NPV impact increases materially and sets an unhelpful precedent for similar customers in this vertical.

Operational asks: include a usage floor, SLA escalator (if they exceed threshold pricing moves to standard list), and a clawback if they churn before 12 months. I created a DocuSign SOW link draft and added the HubSpot deal id to the record.

Links: HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345?dealId=DEAL-2027-327
Draft SOW: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3C_SOW_draft

If Marissa and Rishi are comfortable with the cap, we should present the capped option to Angela this afternoon.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; irene_choi@redwood.ai; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-06T08:09:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Financial impact analysis — Mosaic options (approval)

Approved with conditions.
- Approve a 15% one-time early-volume rebate (applied across months 1–6) + $100k implementation credit.
- Must have: 12-month minimum committed term post-pilot, usage floor spelled out in SOW, and a 6-month clawback if they terminate early.
- No additional commercial concessions permitted (no custom RUs or extended credits).

Ben / Irene — please update the SOW and commercial summary, get Mosaic to sign via DocuSign, and copy Finance on the final execution. Angela — we can present this structure today if that works for your team.

Rishi Malhotra
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
